dockerfile.description: Superseded by the customManager below: this manager cannot rewrite FROM lines whose tag only partially comes from an ARG (ghcr.io/php/pie:${PIE_VERSION}-bin), and emits updates whose replaceString is absent from the file

customManagers.description: Version pins declared as ARG defaults in the Dockerfiles

packageRules.description: Group all GitHub Actions bumps into a single PR

PIE, FrankenPHP and Composer images are tracked via their GitHub releases: GHCR exposes no tag timestamps and Docker Hub resets them on every rebuild, so minimumReleaseAge would stay pending forever. We pin FrankenPHP to a minor version, so only consider vX.Y.0 releases, giving each minor the timestamp of its first release
